identity.title: Air Contaminant Discharge Permit — Compliance Inspection Checklist (Inspector's Field Form)

scan.summary: This is an inspector's field form used by Oregon DEQ during a compliance inspection of a facility holding an Air Contaminant Discharge Permit. It is a blank template that structures the inspection through five sections: permit and submissions, records, and on-site observations. The form is not the permit itself, but a tool to verify that the facility is meeting all ACDP conditions and submitting required reports.
scan.freshness_note: This is a blank checklist template, not a completed inspection record. The date shown is when it was filed; an actual inspection record would have specific responses to each line item and a completed date. A newer version should be requested if Oregon DEQ has issued updates to the checklist structure or required items.

conditions.title: Current ACDP permit available at the facility and not expired
conditions.evidence_expected: The original or certified copy of the current ACDP permit with expiration date shown

conditions.title: Renewal application submitted at least 120 days before permit expiration (when expiration is within 12 months)
conditions.evidence_expected: A dated copy of the renewal application submitted to DEQ, or confirmation from DEQ of receipt more than 120 days before expiration

conditions.title: Annual report for the previous calendar year submitted by February 15
conditions.evidence_expected: A dated copy of the annual report or email confirmation of submission to DEQ

conditions.title: Semi-annual monitoring report for January to June submitted by July 31
conditions.evidence_expected: A dated copy of the semi-annual monitoring report or email confirmation of submission to DEQ

conditions.title: Deviation reports: any deviation in the last 12 months notified within 24 hours and reported in writing within 15 days
conditions.evidence_expected: Log or copies of any deviation notices (written or electronic) sent within 24 hours, and written reports sent within 15 days of each deviation

conditions.title: Scrubber pressure-drop log covering the last 12 months, one reading per operating day, readings within the permitted range
conditions.evidence_expected: A complete 12-month log with dated entries for each operating day showing pressure drop readings and evidence they remained within the permit's specified range

conditions.title: Quarterly scrubber inspection records for the last four quarters
conditions.evidence_expected: Four dated inspection records covering the most recent calendar quarters, with results documented

conditions.title: Carbon replacement record within the last 12 months, or breakthrough records showing replacement was not required
conditions.evidence_expected: Either a dated record of carbon replacement with vendor documentation, or breakthrough detection records showing the carbon remained effective

conditions.title: Weekly detector-tube check records at the carbon unit outlet
conditions.evidence_expected: A log of weekly checks with dates and results, covering the period required by the permit

conditions.title: Opacity observation records, or a statement of the method used to monitor visible emissions
conditions.evidence_expected: Either dated visual opacity observations, or a written description of the monitoring method used and records supporting that method

conditions.title: Records retained for five years and available on request
conditions.evidence_expected: Evidence of a records management system showing all required records (logs, reports, certifications) are kept for five years and immediately accessible

conditions.title: Each scrubber operating with the associated line, pressure drop within range at the time of inspection
conditions.evidence_expected: Visual observation during the inspection, and a pressure-drop gauge reading or recent log entry showing the current reading is within the permitted range

conditions.title: Solvent storage tanks T-3 to T-6 vented to the carbon unit, no open vents or leaks observed
conditions.evidence_expected: Visual observation that all four tanks are connected to the carbon unit outlet, no bypass vents, and no visible liquid or vapor leaks

conditions.title: Tank and line labels legible; permitted sources match the permit's equipment list
conditions.evidence_expected: Legible labels on all tanks and process lines, a copy of the permit's equipment schedule, and visual confirmation that each listed item is present and in service

conditions.title: Facility employee count on the day, for fee tier verification
conditions.evidence_expected: A count of employees present on the inspection date, or payroll records for the week of inspection

conditions.title: Emergency contact and emergency plan available at the facility
conditions.evidence_expected: A copy of the facility's Emergency Action Plan, a written list of emergency contacts posted at an accessible location, and evidence of staff training

deadlines.title: Annual report submission deadline
deadlines.source_line: A3: Annual report for the previous calendar year submitted by February 15

deadlines.title: Semi-annual monitoring report submission deadline
deadlines.source_line: A4: Semi-annual monitoring report for January to June submitted by July 31

deadlines.title: Deviation report written submission deadline
deadlines.source_line: A5: any deviation in the last 12 months... reported in writing within 15 days

deadlines.title: Deviation notification deadline
deadlines.source_line: A5: any deviation in the last 12 months notified within 24 hours

facts.value: Five sections: A (Permit and Submissions), B (Records), C (On the Day)
facts.quote: SECTION A — PERMIT AND SUBMISSIONS, SECTION B — RECORDS, SECTION C — ON THE DAY
facts.affects: The inspection covers permit status, 12-month record completeness, and current operational conditions

facts.value: One pressure-drop reading per operating day, readings must remain within the permitted range
facts.quote: Scrubber pressure-drop log covering the last 12 months, one reading per operating day, readings within the permitted range
facts.affects: Cascade must maintain daily logs if scrubbers operate daily; gaps in the log could result in a violation

facts.value: At least weekly detector-tube checks at the carbon unit outlet
facts.quote: Weekly detector-tube check records at the carbon unit outlet
facts.affects: Cascade must perform and record weekly checks to verify the carbon absorber is not saturated

facts.quote: Records retained for five years and available on request
facts.affects: All inspection records, logs, and reports must be preserved for five years from the date they are generated

facts.value: Solvent storage tanks T-3 to T-6 must be vented to the carbon unit with no open vents
facts.quote: Solvent storage tanks T-3 to T-6 vented to the carbon unit, no open vents or leaks observed
facts.affects: All four tanks must be connected to the carbon control unit; any bypass or vent line is a violation

facts.value: Emergency contact information and emergency plan must be available at the facility
facts.quote: Emergency contact and emergency plan available at the facility
facts.affects: Cascade must have a written, accessible Emergency Action Plan and posted emergency contact list

scan.confidence_notes: This is a blank inspection checklist template issued by Oregon DEQ. I have read its structure and requirements with full confidence. The form itself is not data — it is the tool used to collect data during an inspection. I cannot infer from a blank form what the company's actual compliance status is. An actual inspection record would show which items passed, failed, or were not applicable. The deadline language for permit renewal comes from Oregon's administrative rules (OAR 340-216-0040), which differ by permit type (30 days for Basic, 120 days for Simple, 180 days for Standard). The company's permit number and type are not in this form, so I cannot specify which deadline applies without seeing the actual permit. All other requirements are readable and stated clearly in the form.
